assumptions.assumption: The core value is bedside phenomenology and language, not generic end-of-life logistics.
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: The archive may neglect planning/legal/resource needs users also bring.
assumptions.revisit_trigger: User asks to broaden into care planning or logistics.

assumptions.assumption: The project needs strong ethical and publication gates before it needs many entries.
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: Over-governance may slow first source mining.
assumptions.revisit_trigger: When low-risk public-source pilot records are ready.

assumptions.assumption: Phrase-to-record search is central: users will search with family language, not taxonomy labels.
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: Too much schema may obscure readability.
assumptions.revisit_trigger: When initial records reveal actual query patterns.

assumptions.assumption: No seed cue should be promoted without independent source and review.
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: The archive may become timid and slow, but avoids hallucinated authority.
assumptions.revisit_trigger: Only if the user explicitly requests a looser brainstorming-only layer.

assumptions.assumption: Prior art patterns should be adapted lightly, not copied wholesale into a fragile early corpus.
assumptions.risk_if_wrong: The cube may lack enough machinery for future 10k+ turn integrity.
assumptions.revisit_trigger: At rev0010, compare friction versus continuity gains.
